purpose: Uncover user problems and insights from public feedback to inform photo search UX and IR design.

questions.question: What kinds of old photos do users struggle to retrieve (documents, trips, screenshots, pets, casual objects)?
questions.insight_goal: Surface photo categories tied to failed or frustrating search.
example_search_queries: can't find old photo google photos
handwritten note document search wrong results

questions.question: When users search, does the app return the wrong type of content (e.g., food photos instead of documents)?
questions.insight_goal: Detect semantic/content-type mismatches in retrieval.
example_search_queries: recipe search shows food not document

questions.question: Do users know a photo exists but cannot locate it in a long timeline or backup library?
questions.insight_goal: Separate “exists but unfindable” from true zero-result search.
example_search_queries: thousands of photos can't find one

questions.question: Are failures about finding the one correct photo among many similar ones (same place, person, or event)?
questions.insight_goal: Highlight evaluation/ranking pain vs wrong-category retrieval.

questions.question: Which non-obvious assets are hard to find: screenshots, scans, receipts, chat exports, memes, PDFs saved as images?
questions.insight_goal: Map underserved content types in search indexing.

questions.question: When users search by person or pet, what goes wrong (wrong face group, missing someone, pets confused with people)?
questions.insight_goal: Face/pet clustering failures tied to vague memory queries.
example_search_queries: find photo of my dog search

questions.question: What episodic cues do people explicitly remember (time period, place, event, color, object, emotion)?
questions.insight_goal: Catalog remembered_clues supported by user wording.
example_search_queries: remember kitchen counter blue paper photo

questions.question: Do users remember visual/scene cues more than exact names, dates, or words on the photo?
questions.insight_goal: Compare visual motifs and locations vs precise keywords.
example_search_queries: remember what room photo was taken
can't remember date but remember place

questions.question: Do users remember story context (“after surgery”, “first day at job”) that search cannot accept as a query?
questions.insight_goal: Expression gaps: rich memory vs poor search vocabulary.

questions.question: Do users remember fragments of text on a photo (brand, street sign, headline) but not the full string?
questions.insight_goal: Partial OCR memory vs exact-match search expectations.
example_search_queries: remember part of sign photo search

questions.question: Who else was in the scene, and does that social cue appear in how users describe the search?
questions.insight_goal: People-linked memory without usable face/name filters.

questions.question: What metadata have they forgotten: exact date/year, geotag, album name, filename, or event label?
questions.insight_goal: Identify missing metadata that blocks retrieval.
example_search_queries: don't know date google photos search

questions.question: Do users forget exact words on labels/receipts but still expect text search to work?
questions.insight_goal: Link OCR/handwriting gaps to search failure.

questions.question: Have they forgotten which trip, device, or app captured the photo (WhatsApp vs camera vs screenshot)?
questions.insight_goal: Source/album confusion in large libraries.

questions.question: Do users forget crops, filters, or copies—and search for the wrong version of the image?
questions.insight_goal: Duplicate/edited asset confusion.

questions.question: Do users misremember details (wrong year, wrong city) leading to failed filters or wrong queries?
questions.insight_goal: Human memory error vs product failure.

categories.title: How users search with incomplete memory

questions.question: How do users formulate searches when memory is incomplete (single generic word, place only, person name, object noun)?
questions.insight_goal: Describe user_search_formulation patterns.
example_search_queries: typed location without date hundreds of results

questions.question: Do users fail because they cannot express remembered cues in the search bar (color, scene, layout)?
questions.insight_goal: Separate expression limits from engine interpretation failures.
example_search_queries: can't search by color or scene
no way to filter blue paper

questions.question: Where do users get stuck narrowing results (date range, trip, map, album, device folder)?
questions.insight_goal: Refinement gaps after an overly broad first query.

questions.question: What workarounds do users adopt (endless scroll, Google Lens elsewhere, asking others, exporting to Drive)?
questions.insight_goal: Pain level and substitute behaviors.
example_search_queries: google lens instead of photos search

questions.question: Do users try Ask Photos, voice, or natural-language search—and what breaks in those modes?
questions.insight_goal: New modality failures vs classic keyword search.

questions.question: How many query rewrites happen before users give up, and what do they change between attempts?
questions.insight_goal: Iterative search behavior under uncertainty.

questions.question: At which retrieval stage do failures cluster: expression, interpretation, evaluation, or refinement?
questions.insight_goal: Aggregate failure_stage patterns across feedback.
example_search_queries: too many results can't find one photo

questions.question: What repeated product opportunities could improve Google Photos search (filters, OCR, ranking, guided prompts)?
questions.insight_goal: Synthesize actionable UX/IR improvements.

questions.question: What do users expect search to understand (faces, text, context, memories) vs what it delivers?
questions.insight_goal: Expectation gaps and trust breakdowns.
example_search_queries: expected search to find text in photo

questions.question: Do failures involve indexing lag, backup sync, or missing photos across devices?
questions.insight_goal: Infrastructure vs relevance failures.
example_search_queries: photo not backed up yet search

questions.question: Are features users need (date picker, map, albums, types) hard to discover or removed in UI changes?
questions.insight_goal: UX regressions and hidden refinement tools.
example_search_queries: google photos ui update can't find

questions.question: Does privacy (locked folders, face groups off, location off) block retrieval users expect to work?
questions.insight_goal: Policy/settings vs search capability tension.

questions.question: Do iOS vs Android vs web report different search quality for the same need?
questions.insight_goal: Platform-specific retrieval gaps.
